story.content: Since its founding in 2006, Lider Network has been one of Turkey's most trusted IT infrastructure solution providers. As a Fortinet Authorized Partner, we have completed over 500 successful projects in enterprise cybersecurity, network infrastructure and data storage.

vision.title: Our Vision
